querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      typeofinvestor,
                                      investor_name,
                                      investor_id,
                                      placement,
                                      lockmonth,
                                      ann_ordqty,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      refund_payback_amount,
                                      share_type,
                                      tradable_dt,
                                      latest_own_qty,
                                      latest_own_qty_financing,
                                      investor_type_code,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cbondplacementdetails.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cbondplacementdetails WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
